summary.text: Kermit Williams is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served in the chamber.

paragraphs.text: Kermit Williams, a Democrat, represented Hillsborough 4 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, assuming office on December 5, 2012 and leaving office on December 1, 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists him as serving on the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in the 2013-2014, 2015 and 2017 legislative sessions.
He was a Democratic candidate for Hillsborough 32 in the 2022 general election, in which he did not win a seat, and advanced from the Democratic primary for that district on September 8, 2026.
